title: Hi, I’m Reinout
text:
I like solving problems with data.
I recently graduated with a Master’s degree in Statistics & Data Science from UHasselt. My interests range from statistical modelling and machine learning to data visualization and bioinformatics. I enjoy exploring new ideas, building reproducible analyses, and turning complex results into something people can actually use.
This website contains some of the projects I’ve worked on, including interactive dashboards, machine learning research, and other data science projects.
One example is an interactive dashboard on air pollution that Sophie and I created for a data visualization course: https://dataviz-5zhh.onrender.com/
